policy.same_system: Preserve the complete imported native state.
policy.cross_system: Translate through a canonical character record, validate target-specific choices, preserve unmapped source data, and require review.

reviewNotes: Target-system legality is checked against the reference catalogs bundled with TableGate.
A suggested match does not override campaign-runner rulings, source ownership, rarity, prerequisites, or variant rules.
Unsupported features remain visible in the import audit so the runner can select a better legal replacement.
